name: manual_arabic_naturalness_grammar_review
method: manual prose read of compact title/text snapshots; only high-confidence MSA grammar, case-form, idiom, and naturalness defects are repaired; stylistic preferences alone are not edits

b1.note: Full B1 manual prose read was performed only after all 60 B1 passages had completed Pass-03/07 length and assessment recalibration. Exact passage-scoped repairs were assertion-guarded; stylistic-only alternatives were intentionally left unchanged.

b2.note: Full B2 manual prose read was performed only after all 60 B2 passages had completed Pass-03/07 length and assessment recalibration. The full pass applied 21 exact assertion-guarded repairs across 20 passages; the total also includes one earlier independently detected comparative-naturalness repair in ar-b2-u04-p06, which was subsequently reviewed again in the full pass. Stylistic-only alternatives were intentionally left unchanged.

c1.note: Full C1 manual prose read was performed only after all 60 C1 passages had completed Pass-03/07 length and assessment recalibration. The repair batch applied 29 exact high-confidence MSA grammar/idiom/collocation repairs across 23 passages; assessment, new-target, review-target, and literal new-target occurrence contracts were assertion-guarded. Stylistic-only alternatives were intentionally left unchanged.

c2.note: ar-c2-u01-p03 received a separate lexical-sense/naturalness normalization for مبرر; full level manual pass should follow the major Pass-07 length recalibration.
